project_type: Monorepo: React Native (Expo) mobile apps + React/Vite web dashboards + Node.js/Express API
build_system: npm workspaces root; each app has own package.json. Mobile: Expo SDK 51. Web: Vite 5. Backend: ts-node / compiled with tsc.
test_framework: vitest in web apps (admin-panel, operator-dashboard); no test suite for mobile apps
build_command: Per-app: `npm run build` (web apps) | `npx expo export --platform web` (mobile, type-check only) | `npx tsc --noEmit` (api-gateway)
verification_instructions: 1. For backend changes: cd services/api-gateway && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. For web app changes: cd apps/<app> && npm run build. 3. For mobile app changes: cd apps/<app> && npx expo export --platform web (catches TypeScript errors). 4. For DB migrations: inspect SQL syntax manually; migrations run at deploy time.
environment_constraints: Deployment is Vercel (web) + Render (backend) free tier. NEVER use Socket.io for real-time — use HTTP polling only (setInterval + fetch/axios). No push to main; commit locally on branch only.
contribution_requirements: HTTP polling pattern only. No Socket.io. Auth token patterns must match existing patterns per app (see below). Admin panel is MISSING recharts/axios/lucide-react in package.json — must install before using them.
key_patterns: Passenger/Driver app: AsyncStorage.getItem('@dalasmart:token') for JWT. API base: process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? 'https://safiri-salama.vercel.app/api/v1'. Admin panel: localStorage.getItem('admin_token') + native fetch wrapper in services/api.ts. Operator dashboard: localStorage.getItem('operator_token') + axios instance in services/api.ts. Backend routes: pool.query() with $1/$2 params. All routes under /api/v1/. Admin routes require userType='admin' check.
directory_structure: apps/passenger-app/ — React Native Expo, screens/ at root (no src/), navigation/ at root. apps/driver-app/ — React Native Expo, all screens under src/screens/{main,profile,trip,auth}/. apps/admin-panel/ — React+Vite, src/pages/, src/components/, src/services/. apps/operator-dashboard/ — React+Vite+Tailwind, src/pages/, src/components/, src/services/, src/hooks/. services/api-gateway/ — Express, src/routes/, src/middleware/, src/database/. infrastructure/database/postgres/migrations/ — SQL migration files.
